replies.author: Swagdreas
replies.body:
I like where this is going, but as an experienced builder I do have a few things to say.

1. If this is a city, what sort of theme do you have for it?
What I mean by this is, is it futuristic or medieval or even just a city like New York City.
2. What's with the rainbows?
What I mean by this is why does the top structure of the bridge in a whole bunch of different colors. If you keep it like this it'll look childish and very unprofessional. What I suggest doing is keeping it with one theme and instead start using either Stone, Quartz, Wood or anything else that makes it look very realistic.

If you want any help building or want anymore tips just add me on skype: bestbigcat
